name: Fiber Uppercut — Christmas (example)
subject: A Fiber Uppercut Christmas sale, just for you
preheader: Wrap up the year with your daily fiber habit.

data.headline: Give your gut a gift this Christmas
data.image_alt: A tub of Fiber Uppercut wrapped like a Christmas present next to a glass of water

data.heading: The best gift is one you give yourself
data.body:
Between the cookies, the dinners and the second helpings, your gut's had a season. Fiber Uppercut is a once-a-day powder that mixes into water, smoothies or coffee in seconds. Citrus-peach flavor, no grit, no gluten.

Mix one scoop with 8 oz of liquid. Stir, sip, done. Grab it before the Christmas sale ends.

Try it for $10.
